architecture_hypothesis.candidate_generator: Reuse existing local project-scoped lexical/path/symbol/FTS5 ranking and current source validation.
architecture_hypothesis.correction: Separate implementation-body, declaration/annotation, metadata and prose evidence; type-rich lexical overlap alone must not establish runtime relevance.
non_goals: No claim of semantic execution/dependency completeness
No claim of globally best architecture or SaaS readiness
retained_boundaries: Complete selected source, all-or-nothing fallback and exact original task
Bounded current-body evidence and losing-competitor revalidation
Trusted isolated parser workers and no indexed module execution
Existing source-only/v1/v2 and optional-memory behavior; no default promotion without evidence

important_semantic_caveats: TypeScript classes and mixed files can have both type and runtime roles.
Python annotations are not universally erased; call these evidence-origin channels rather than executed/never-executed semantics.
Current upstream grammar schema and Codex main can differ from installed pinned production versions.
Current Codex source maps cache-write counters where supplied; missing/old usage is not measured zero or evidence of actual billing.
A post-query SKIP still incurs refresh/retrieval/parse work.

remaining_limits: Python ast.parse allocates its tree before iterative node/deadline checks. Isolated child faults and parent timeout contain failures;2MiB source cap is not a strict AST RSS cap or hard3s parse interrupt.
Full secure refresh/Git/database writes have other waits, including existing30s DB busy timeout. New SQL phase renewal is not an end-to-end deadline.
All implementation/type roles and TYPE_CHECKING/type intent rules are syntactic heuristics, not compiler execution/erasure or semantic relevance proofs. Python annotations can have runtime effects.
Top4 units/role are a bounded retained representation; best semantic scope, dependency closure and useful recall are not guaranteed.
Candidate generation can miss synonyms/targets, unsupported/malformed competitors force whole-operation fallback, and an explicit path intentionally overrides evidence strength.
No fresh target coverage, coding correctness, native token/cost effects, actual billing, or hosted operational-readiness conclusion follows from this review.
independent_pre_freeze_review.scope: Independent read-only pre-freeze production/integration and security/resource review. No tests, preparers, syntax workers, repository code, authentication or models executed by this review; no fresh evaluation corpus read.

pre_evaluation_owner_contract.ambiguity: Explicit top conflicts only with explicit competitor. Otherwise sufficient independent competitor triggers abstention if body sets equal, top body count is not strictly greater, or top total body/header term count is smaller. No strict-subset requirement.
pre_evaluation_owner_contract.candidate_weight: log1p((candidate_count+.5)/(candidate_presence+.5)); presence across eligible retained units; heuristic only
pre_evaluation_owner_contract.evidence: Best bounded syntax unit; implementation code, clean headers and annotation/type role separate; no signature prose sufficiency
pre_evaluation_owner_contract.scope: Owner contract before independent code review and fresh corpus; not efficacy or safety result
pre_evaluation_owner_contract.sufficiency: Eligible explicit current anchor, or at least two distinct matched code/header terms including at least one actual requested-role code term
pre_evaluation_owner_contract.task_role: Runtime default; explicit static-type intent or current declaration anchor may justify type work

prior_evidence_not_pooled.automatic_v2: Known-path target scope24/24; new-v2scope0/24 and two type-only preloads; no native model dispatch.
prior_evidence_not_pooled.historical_source_only: 9.055% partial warm estimate and10.19% focused confirmation estimate are separate historical cohorts, not current-v3 results or billed savings.
prior_evidence_not_pooled.request_local_ignore_cache: Half duplicate compilations, identical context/read checks; no reliable mean-latency or new model-cost win.

production_scope: Tested local release candidate within recorded platforms/load only. Remote auth, tenant isolation, TLS, billing, recovery, SLOs and explicit retention/quotas require separate implementation and verification.
provenance_limits: Mutable branch URLs identified by exact downloaded bytes, not commit resolution.
Repoformer/RepoCoder complete papers not freshly downloaded this round; selected earlier paper readings remain in historical research ledgers.
No new prices, model acceptance, coding correctness, token usage or bills measured.
required_report_categories: Existing application and installed transport correctness
Source freshness, approval and resource security
Frozen fresh path-free coverage/negative controls without grader leakage
Cold/warm whole preparation CPU/wall and scoped RSS including child work
Native strict success, observed token availability and cost per success only if actually run
Actual billed charges unavailable without invoices
All historical failures and new negative outcomes preserved
